# Scale model art credits

The Railway Rush realism pass uses these assets under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- Asphalt Track by Dimitrios Savva. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_track)
- Fine Grained Wood by Rob Tuytel. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/fine_grained_wood)
- Gravel Floor 04 by Charlotte Baglioni. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/gravel_floor_04)
- Locomotive by 32kda. The game uses the original atlas and a Unity OBJ conversion of the supplied glTF mesh. [OpenGameArt asset](https://opengameart.org/content/locomotive-1)
- Toy Car by Guido Odendahl, with materials by Eric Chadwick. The game uses an optimized OBJ conversion, the original paint atlas, and four independently animated wheels. [Khronos model](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/ToyCar) · [Model license](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/main/Models/ToyCar/LICENSE.md)
- Low-Poly Craftsman House 1 by MrJaneLAB. The game uses the original house-only FBX and its embedded color palette. [Publisher download and license](https://mrjanelab.itch.io/low-poly-craftsman-house-lods-included)
- Red Brick by Rob Tuytel. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/red_brick)
- Clay Roof Tiles 02 by Amal Kumar. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/clay_roof_tiles_02)
